territories.name: Seychelles
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Seychelles levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act 2010 (Act 35 of 2010): the Third Schedule sets it at fifteen percent, the Second Schedule zero-rates exports and the other supplies it lists, Part II of the First Schedule exempts the supplies it lists, and the Seychelles Revenue Commission takes a monthly return.
